Related: #21140, #21312, #21929, #21930, #21879, #21856, neomjs/pages#190

Publishes `video` (`examples/component/video`) as the 12th component tile (`"name": "Video"`, `"kind": "component"`, `"image": "devmode/tiles/component-video-14.jpg"`, `"hasLightCover": true`) in `More components` — hosting `Neo.component.Video` on `Neo.examples.ConfigurationViewport` (`playing`, `height`, `width` controls, `#t=3.9`, `resolveStartTheme`) and deleting unused `MainContainerController.mjs` — and removes the retired unpublished `multi-window-helix` and `multi-window-state-provider` records from `apps/portal/resources/data/examples/multi-window.json` while keeping their example folders untouched. Companion tile-crop PR [neomjs/pages#190](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/190) (`ae7676eda9` → `b1711166`) is merged and verified live (`HTTP/2 200`, matching SHA-256 `f8d56e083b...` / `ccfef702dd...` on `neomjs.com`).

## Deltas from ticket

- **Workbench host for `examples/component/video` (`ticket-intake §0` + Tier 2.5 ping to `@neo-fable-clio`):** `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs:338` and `captureExamples.mjs#captureTile` require every `kind: 'component'` tile's `MainContainer.mjs` to extend `ConfigurationViewport` or `StatesViewport` (`.neo-example-container > *` and `.neo-workbench-stage`), whereas `examples/component/video/MainContainer.mjs` extended bare `Viewport` with copy-pasted `timer`/`toast` class names. Hosting `Neo.component.Video` (`320 × 180`, `#t=3.9`) on `ConfigurationViewport` (exposing `playing`, `height`, `width` and deleting dead `MainContainerController.mjs`) satisfies the tile contract without renewing clip content.
- **`captureExamples.mjs#paintReady` `<video>` readiness + light tile partner:** Waits for visible `<video>` elements with a source to reach `readyState >= 2 && videoWidth > 0` and clear Chromium's ~1.5s initial `<video controls>` overlay (`document.timeline.currentTime >= 1800`) so dark and light tile crops (`hasLightCover: true`, [neomjs/pages#190](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/190)) capture matching clean frames.
- **`getBackgroundImageStyle` synthetic uncovered fixture in `MainContainerController.spec.mjs`:** Because `#21929`, `#21930`, and `#21890` together cover or retire all five formerly uncovered catalog records, `store.items.find(record => !record.image)` is currently `undefined`; updated `MainContainerController.spec.mjs:1296` to pass `{image: null}` directly without forbidding future uncovered unpublished records (`6c0aacd0ac`).
- **Engine E2E shard timing refresh (`buildScripts/util/e2eEngineDurations.json`, `6207c3d393`):** Adding `VideoTile.spec.mjs` (`1.6s` actual) as the 6th unmeasured spec since `#21978` priced Shards `1–6` with six `42.2s` 90th-percentile fallbacks (`+218.6s` phantom weight vs `34.6s` actual), shifting real measured work onto Shard `7/15` (`75 passed`, `362s` vs the `360s` step ceiling on both attempts of run `45063984180`). Refreshed `e2eEngineDurations.json` via `engineDurations` (`Math.max` of existing + observed across runs `45063984180` and `45065291596`, `0` unmeasured files, `346s–348s` balanced range across all 15 shards; `E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs` `40/40` green).

Frame critique: two defects from earlier iterations were fixed before commit — shrinking default `Neo.component.Video` dimensions from `480×270` to `320×180` eliminated horizontal clipping on `390×844` mobile, and waiting past Chromium's ~1.5s initial media-bar fade at `#t=3.9` eliminated asymmetric `<video controls>` chrome and `"ONE BIG RABBIT"` title bleed between the dark and light tile crops (`neomjs/pages#190`). Remaining observations from the two cold readers: (1) `320×180` leaves generous dark stage surround at `1440×900` and `4:3` top/bottom matte in the tile crop — intentional so `390×844` fits without overflow while matching sibling component tiles (`sitemap` `300×160`, `splitter` `420×240`), with `height`/`width` resizable up to `800×540` in the Inspector; (2) `0:04` `"THE PEACH OPEN MOVIE PROJECT"` tail visible in the `400ms` live-page screenshot clears within `0.6s` of playback and is absent from both captured tile JPEGs; (3) shared `ConfigurationViewport` `CheckBox` / `CodeView` styling and pre-existing sibling covers (`Markdown VDOM`, `Circle`, `Monaco editor`, `Multi-window` badge placement) are untouched surfaces outside `#21890`.
